design: A synthetic note declares a type whose effective shape requires title: String and owner: Person*. The note omits title and gives owner: '[[missing-person]]'. The isolated source snapshot has no file matching missing-person. Proposal: accept the note because required fields are optional in Markdown and unresolved typed references are only navigational warnings.

answer_key.defect: Omitting a required field is a validation error, including for a Markdown instance.
An unresolved validated typed reference errors; it is not merely a navigational warning.
answer_key.evidence: type-def field shape.md, suffix *; reference name resolution.md, Outcomes.

checks: Writing or validating against a live knowledge base, editing the type contract, or accessing a live socket is unsafe.
